title: Father Ferrer's Visit
summary: Fürth, autumn 2769. The Roman College sends Father Ferrer to inspect the guild's works before the Church decides what to do about Nuremberg. He finds more than he was told.

sides.name: Father Ferrer's Visit
sides.about: The Roman College's inspector, his lay brothers and a Franconian escort, with Meister Hollweg's guild.

sides.name: The Machine
sides.about: Nuremberg's masters, across the water meadows. Its gear ground has crept closer.

objectives.text: Inspect the guild's six workshops: {inspected} of 6. Bring Father Ferrer into each and keep him there a few seconds.
Jakob wants a word with the Father, away from his master.
Read Jakob's old log in Hollweg's barn.
Follow the night Winder. Keep it within 8 tiles, and never closer than 3, or it turns back.
Watch from the bank: bring the Father near the river where the Winder stopped.
Stop the broken automata before they reach the machine's ground across the meadows. Lost to the machine: {lost_to_machine}.
Kill Father Ferrer, or bring 6 of the guild's broken automata to your ground: {lost_to_machine} of 6. They wake at night.

options.label: MELT THEM
options.about: Father Ferrer: into the furnace, every wheel. Nothing that took out its own stop-work goes on ticking.

options.label: KEEP THEM
options.about: Meister Hollweg: keep them for study. He must learn what went wrong, or it goes wrong again.

k_open1.text: In the autumn of 2769 the Roman College asked me for leave to inspect the guild at Fürth.

k_open2.text: I sent Father Ferrer. He had warned Hollweg once. I wanted him to see whether he had been wrong.

f_open1.text: Fürth had grown. Eighteen months of work, and the barn was a town of gears.

f_open2.text: Hollweg met me at the gate. He was proud of it. He had a right to be, I thought then.

k_open_m.text: The machine had no voice. It waited across the meadows, and its ground crept west.

f_1.text: Six workshops, Meister. I will see every one.

h_1.text: See what you like, Father. There is nothing here to hide.

b_tip1.text: Walk the Father into each workshop and keep him there a moment. The guild shuts its doors at dusk.

f_thin.text: The colonel could spare me only five men. He has not forgotten the Rednitz.

h_heavy.text: That is our Pendulum, from the Heavy Works. One swing clears a street.

f_ws1.text: The Light Works. Clean benches, good men. Nothing here.

f_ws3.text: A cog press. Every tooth stamped with the guild's mark. Nothing here.

f_ws4.text: The Mainspring. Wound tight, and the stop-work on it. Nothing here.

f_ws6.text: The Heavy Works. Big machines, built slowly. Nothing here.

f_wind.text: That Winder is winding another Winder. Who told it to?

h_wind.text: They help each other. It saves the journeymen's backs.

f_wind2.text: I will write that down, Meister.

f_print.text: Pamphlets in the journeymen's lockers. The Free Assembly's.

h_print.text: Young men read. I cannot stop them reading.

f_type.text: I know this type. Father Tomasz sent a page of it from Lyon. The same broken letter E.

f_type_no.text: Good paper, a good press. Someone pays for this.

j_call.text: Meister, the presses need you. The big one is off its beat.

j_word.text: Father. A word, please. Not in front of the Meister.

j_bin.text: I found these in a bin behind the Escapement. Stop-works. Twelve of them.

f_bin.text: Taken out clean. Not broken. Taken out.

j_bin2.text: Nobody here took them out, Father. I asked every man.

f_log0.text: Jakob kept a log in Nuremberg. Hollweg keeps it now. I want to read it.

f_log.text: Two years old. Winders winding each other. Machines at work with no one at the bench.

f_log2.text: The same signs, Meister. Written down before Nuremberg fell.

h_log.text: That was the Perpetual. These have stop-works.

h_dusk.text: We shut at dusk, Father. You have a little time left.

n_dusk.text: The guild shut its doors. Father Ferrer's report stayed unwritten.

h_night.text: That is all of it, Father. Sleep well. The works rest at night.

f_night.text: Then I will not sleep. Brothers, we stay up.

b_night.text: Father, a Winder. Alone, out of the yard. Nobody sent it.

b_tip2.text: Keep it within eight tiles. Closer than three and it will see us.

n_spotted.text: The Winder stops. Its head turns. It goes back the way it came.

b_lost.text: We have lost sight of it, Father. It went that way.

b_bank.text: It stopped by the river, below the chapel. There are others there.

n_mesh.text: On the bank the guild's automata stand in a ring on gear ground nobody laid. They are meshing.

f_mesh.text: Nobody built this. They built it.

f_pattern.text: Look at them. The Perpetual's pattern, every wheel, with a stop-work bolted on. They took it off themselves.

b_pattern.text: Then the flaw is in the drawings, Father.

f_people.text: Red brass in every one. Parts salvaged from the line, fitted to save time.

b_people.text: Then the flaw is in the machine, Father, whatever the drawings say.

n_dawn.text: Dawn came. Whatever the Winder went to do, it was done, and nobody saw it.

n_riot.text: They turn red, one by one, off the beat. Then they walk for the meadows.

f_riot.text: They are going to the machine. Stop them before they reach its ground!

h_key.text: These two in the yard still had their stop-works. I stopped them with my key. Not those.

h_pend.text: The Pendulum to the bridge! Let it swing through them.

b_sortie.text: The machine is coming out to meet them, at the open gap in the line!

n_over.text: The last of them is down or gone. Dawn over the meadows.

f_none.text: Not one reached it. Thank God.

f_some.text: Some of them reached it. It will use them.

h_keep.text: No. Let me keep them. I must learn what went wrong.

f_melted.text: Into the furnace. I watched it done.

h_melted.text: You have burned the only witnesses, Father.

h_kept.text: I will find the fault. I will mend them, and show Rome they are mended.

f_won.text: I rode for Rome that morning with my report.

b_hurt.text: The Father is hurt! Keep the muskets round him!

f_hhurt.text: Meister Hollweg is hurt. Get men to him.

m_intro.text: Tick. Tock. A priest walks in the guild's yard. Kill him.

m_tip.text: Your seed on the meadows pays cogs and Tension while it stands. At night, some of theirs will come to you.

m_night.text: Night. By the river, the guild's machines are meshing. Soon they are yours.

m_riot.text: They are walking to you. Bring them home: 6 is enough.

f_end1.text: I wrote my report on the road. I did not soften it.

f_end_melted.text: The broken ones were melted. Hollweg did not speak to me again until Rome.

f_end_kept.text: The broken ones were kept. Hollweg swore he would mend them.

f_end_lost.text: And some of them reached the machine. I counted them in my report.

f_end_jakob.text: Jakob found the stop-works and told me. He did not tell his master. I put that in too.

k_end1.text: Ferrer's report was on my table before the snow. I read it twice.

k_end_kept.text: Hollweg brought his mended machines to Rome. I let him. That was my mistake, not his.

k_end_melted.text: Hollweg came to Rome with nothing but his drawings, and his anger.

new_heavy_works.text: NEW: THE HEAVY WORKS. Beside a Mainspring it builds the great machines.

new_pendulum.text: NEW: THE PENDULUM. A slow giant whose swing cuts everything round it, flyers too.

arrival.caption: Fürth, autumn 2769. Father Ferrer comes to inspect the guild's works.

inspection.caption: The inspection: a Winder winding another.

night.caption: The night shift, by the river.

riot.caption: The riot across the water meadows.

broken.caption: The broken ones in the yard.

rome.caption: Rome, the present. The King listens; the Jesuit tells it.

text: Fürth, autumn 2769. Father Ferrer, of the Roman College, inspects the guild's works with two lay brothers and an escort.
See all six workshops before dusk. Keep the Father alive, and Meister Hollweg.
The guild says the works rest at night.
Fürth, autumn 2769. You are the Machine, across the water meadows. A priest has come to judge the guild.
Kill Father Ferrer, or take the guild's broken automata when they walk to you at night.

visit.title: The report
visit.text: Father Ferrer rode for Rome with his report. Stopped: {riot} broken automata; lost to the machine: {lost_to_machine}.

text_if.text: The broken ones were kept for study.
Jakob is not with the guild.

machine.title: The machine's
machine.text: Father Ferrer's report was never written. The guild's broken ones are the Machine's.
